documentationReorganization.title: Documentation Reorganization Script Execution Plan
documentationReorganization.summary: A comprehensive plan to resolve script execution issues and successfully complete the Documentation Reorganization Project.

missingRequiredTools.description: The execute-accelerated-plan.bat script reports missing required tools during verification.
missingRequiredTools.cause: Script path resolution issues when checking for tools from workspace root.
missingRequiredTools.resolution: Create a verification script that properly checks tool existence and updates path references.

scriptExecutionEnvironment.description: Script execution interrupted due to unmet prerequisites or configuration issues.
scriptExecutionEnvironment.cause: Running script from incorrect directory (U5-Data\Documentation\Tools instead of workspace root).
scriptExecutionEnvironment.resolution: Create an enhanced wrapper script that ensures execution from workspace root.

symbolicLinkRequirements.description: Reorganization requires symbolic links which need administrator privileges.
symbolicLinkRequirements.cause: Script lacks proper handling for cases without admin privileges.
symbolicLinkRequirements.resolution: Implement alternative symbolic link handling with detection of admin status.

directoryStructureVerification.description: Mismatch between expected and actual directory structure.
directoryStructureVerification.cause: Incomplete directory structure required by the scripts.
directoryStructureVerification.resolution: Create a directory verification and creation script to ensure all required directories exist.

pathResolution.description: Path resolution issues when navigating nested directories.
pathResolution.resolution: Update scripts to use proper path resolution with Join-Path.

activities.name: Directory Structure Verification and Creation
activities.objective: Ensure all required directories exist with proper structure.
steps: Verify creation of all required directories

activities.name: Script Path Correction
activities.objective: Update script path references to ensure they work from workspace root.

activities.name: Tool Verification
activities.objective: Verify all required tools exist and are properly referenced.
steps: Confirm all required tools are present

activities.name: Create Enhanced Execution Wrapper
activities.objective: Create an improved wrapper script that addresses path and permission issues.
steps: Create and apply enhanced-logging.ps1 for better diagnostics

activities.name: Backup Creation
activities.objective: Create a comprehensive backup before executing reorganization.

activities.name: Execute the Enhanced Wrapper
activities.objective: Run the reorganization with all the improvements in place.
steps: Follow on-screen prompts and confirm execution

activities.name: Symbolic Link Handling
activities.objective: Properly create symbolic links or alternatives if administrator access is unavailable.
steps: Verify symbolic links if admin privileges available
Create manual-symlink-creation.ps1 if admin privileges unavailable
Execute symbolic link commands in admin command prompt

activities.name: Verification
activities.objective: Verify all documents were moved correctly and all references are updated.
steps: Create and execute manual-fixes.ps1 if needed

activities.name: Cleanup
activities.objective: Clean up temporary files and finalize the reorganization.

activities.name: Update Memory and Changelog
activities.objective: Document the successful reorganization in memory.md and changelog.md.
steps: Verify updates to memory.md and changelog.md

activities.name: Create Execution Summary
activities.objective: Document the execution process and results.
steps: Verify creation of execution summary document

resourceRequirements.name: Administrator Access
resourceRequirements.alternatives: Manual symbolic link creation process if unavailable

resourceRequirements.name: Execution Time
resourceRequirements.description: Approximately 1-2 days depending on the volume of documentation

resourceRequirements.name: Backup Space
resourceRequirements.description: Minimum 2x the size of current documentation

riskManagement.mitigation: Enhanced logging, phased approach, backup creation
Alternative symbolic link handling with manual process

successCriteria: All documentation properly relocated to departmental directories
All references updated to reflect new document locations
Backward compatibility maintained through symbolic links
Execution summary and final report created
